dedupe_keys.name: tpldetect thermography based pipeline leak detection for district heating

description: TPLDetect is open-source software that detects leaks in district heating pipelines by automatic analysis of drone-based thermal infrared imagery. It was written by Elena Vollmer and archived with her doctoral dissertation on thermography-based leak detection in district heating systems. The pipeline covers preprocessing (georeferencing, masking and temperature extraction), thermal anomaly detection with the transformer model TASeg, removal of false alarms with the CNN model TUFSeg, and post-processing and mapping of leak candidates. Inputs are thermal R.JPEG images such as from FLIR cameras, pipeline locations, and a LOD1 building model and terrain model, set through a YAML configuration. The method is location-independent. It is a Python package run through Docker or locally, tested on Ubuntu 22.04 with Python 3.10, and the dissertation version of March 2026 is archived on Zenodo under BSD-3-Clause at no cost. Caveats: only Python 3.10 is supported, the release mirrors a dissertation, and results depend on the flight and camera. Simulation uses are condition monitoring of heat networks and planning of repairs. Related records: data-uas-thermal-imagery-district-heating-leaks holds training data.
